$comment: Reviewed, intentional differences from the golden baseline, read by tests/e2e/route-inventory.spec.ts. Only soft fields can be approved: description, keywords, og:title, og:description, og:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale, og:type, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image:alt. Shape: routes["/path"]["field"] = { "value": "exact new text" | null (removed), "reason": "why" }. Hard fields (title, canonical, og:url, robots, OG image, anchors, JSON-LD coverage, EnquiryRouter intent, print hooks, headers, sitemap order, redirects) cannot be approved here. An approval that matches the baseline again fails as stale. The top-level "visible" list is a review log, not read by the tests: every intentional change to visible page copy, link targets or a recorded deviation from the design spec, as { routes, change, reason }.

visible.change: 'Start a business enquiry' (hero chevron, sectors routing cell, closing pill) goes to /contact instead of /partnerships.
visible.reason: C0: the same general enquiry target as every site-wide Enquire action.

visible.change: Mobile quick-contact bar: Call, WhatsApp and Email are quiet icon-over-label actions and the one pill is Enquire (to /contact); the Email pill is gone. The tel:, wa.me/ and mailto: hrefs are unchanged.
visible.reason: C0: the plan's 'Call · WhatsApp · Enquire'; the mailto: action stays for conversion tracking and the QuickContact contract.

(dropped 'on the Tanzania–Zambia border'); sectors lede rewritten as 'Start from your need: each sector opens onto its service, the company behind it and the way to enquire.'; corridor lede shortened to '..., with direct access to cross-border flows.'.
visible.reason: C0: centred ledes ran six lines at 360px (critic round 3); each now sets in four lines or fewer on a phone.

visible.change: Company tile summaries shortened (Mwanjalisi Oil, Westsides, Itemba Enterprises) to about 130-145 characters.

visible.reason: C0: the branch row restated the Branches table directly above it (critic round 3).

visible.change: Deviation: the company hero sets its photograph beside the text (square, 440px column) rather than below it, whenever the photograph is not a 2000px landscape master.
visible.reason: C0: the only strong Westsides and Enterprises frames are phone-resolution portraits (the WESTSIDES signboard, the tanker); a 1068px frame would show them soft. Square keeps the text and the photograph about the same height.

visible.change: Deviation: at 360px the home h1 renders at about 40px, below display-xl's 48px floor.
visible.reason: The no-split rule for 'Tanzania–Zambia' takes precedence: the compound is about 7.6em wide and must fit the 316px line; the h1 still leads every other heading by 1.2x or more.

visible.change: Cover: eyebrow 'Company Profile and Capability Statement' becomes 'Prepared for institutional review' (the print cover's kicker); the lede ends at '… operating through three independent companies.' (the sector list follows in 'At a glance'); the cover photograph is ITEMBA-MPEMBA from the highway (mpemba-station-roadside) instead of the forecourt with the fuel-price pylon, and its caption line is dropped.
visible.reason: P6: the eyebrow no longer repeats the h1 ('Itemba Group / Company Profile'); a 220-character lede ran seven lines on a phone; the pylon's live prices date the page (media.ts note).

visible.change: Downloads and print: the hero's primary action is 'Download PDF' (the group profile, download attribute); the four PDFs move into a 'Download or print the profile.' section of cards, each 'Download PDF ›', beside 'Print the live profile' and the print picker. The old 'Download PDF' heading and the note 'Ready-made snapshots — use Print above for the live, current page.' are replaced by that section's copy.
visible.reason: P6 (plan: 'Download cards for the four PDFs'): banks and partners take the profile away first; the hrefs, download attributes and the picker's contract are unchanged.

visible.change: Link targets: 'Send enquiry' (hero) and the sub-nav 'Enquire' pill go to the form on the page (#enquire, in Contact Information) instead of /contact; new 'Request documents ›' (Attachments) goes there too. The group phone numbers and inbox in Overview and Contact Information become tel:/mailto: links (the secondary line's tel: is new).
visible.reason: PAGE-GUIDE §1: a page with its own form links #enquire; contact hrefs come from src/content/contact.ts in the forms ConversionTracker classifies.

visible.change: Target Market lists the four audience groups of the group print document (fuel and corridor; Westsides wholesale, hospitality and construction; logistics and transit; institutional and stakeholder) instead of two company groups plus an 11-item list that repeated them; the corridor opportunity leads the chapter. Company History is in date order ('2017 onward' now follows '9 June 2017'), which the group PDF picks up when regenerated.
visible.reason: P6: the same markets, each listed once, and the same list on screen and on paper; architecture §2 invariant: the history is chronological.

visible.change: Photographs: the screen view shows three (the cover; the ITEMBA-HARDWARE storefront under the WESTSIDES signboard beside the Westsides branches; the truck line at UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD) instead of seven per-branch photographs with blurred backdrops; the org chart becomes a 'Group structure' diagram (Itemba Group — 'Central strategic oversight, governance and coordination' — over its three companies); the operating-company cards gain a decorative 'Explore ›'.
visible.reason: Owner photo rule: the best photographs, sparingly, at most one canopy here; the diagram's line restates the ownership summary's second point.

visible.change: Deviation: the sticky sub-nav is titled 'Profile' (the global nav's label) rather than the page name, and carries no anchor links: its Contents control (ProfileNav) lists the 17 sections. Each chapter shows a decorative two-digit number above its h2 (the contents sheet's numbering); most chapters set the heading beside the content (5/7 columns, as the reference FAQ and enquiry sections).
visible.reason: 'Company profile' truncates beside Contents and the Enquire pill at 360px; seventeen anchors do not fit a bar; the numbers and the two columns make a 17-chapter page read as a report.
